quiz.q: 'හෙට මේ වෙලාවේ මම ගුවනින් යනවා' — කොහොමද?
options: This time tomorrow I will fly.
This time tomorrow I will be flying.
This time tomorrow I will flying.
This time tomorrow I am flying now.
quiz.explainSi: ඒ මොහොතේ මැදින් — will be flying.
quiz.speak: This time tomorrow I will be flying.

options: When you will come, call me.
As soon as he leaves, tell me.
quiz.explainSi: when, while, until, as soon as — මේවාට පස්සේ will යෙදෙන්නේ නෑ.

options: I want to be a manager.
I would like to become a manager.

quiz.q: 'I'm looking forward to ___ you.' — හිස් තැනට?
quiz.speak: I'm looking forward to meeting you.

quiz.q: හිස් තැනට: 'I'm saving money ___ I can go next year.'

options: I came here in order to study.
I came here for my studies.
quiz.explainSi: අරමුණ කියන්න 'to study'; 'for' එකට පස්සේ නාම පදයක්.

options: will එකට කලින්, won't එකට පස්සේ
will එකට පස්සේ, won't එකට කලින්
quiz.explainSi: She will probably come. / She probably won't come.
maybe ක්‍රියා විශේෂණයක් — 'Maybe she is at home.'
'It can't be true.' — mustn't කියන්නේ 'කරන්න එපා'.

quiz.q: 'ලයිට් දාලා, ඒ නිසා ඇතුළේ කවුරු හරි ඇති' — කොහොමද?
quiz.speak: The lights are on, so somebody must be inside.

options: must be → might be → can't be
can't be → might be → must be
might be → must be → can't be
must be → can't be → might be
quiz.explainSi: must be (95%) → might be (50%) → can't be (5%).

quiz.q: හිස් තැනට: 'Don't call at seven — I ___.'
